śrī saṃpuṭodbhava tantra 

[Elder, G.R., The Saṃpuṭa tantra: edition and translation, chapters I-IV. Unpublished Ph. D. dissertation submitted to Columbia University, 1978]







THE SAṂPUṬA TANTRA - SANSKRIT EDITION 



(Chapter 1) <<pp36-63>> 

(oṃ) namo vajraḍākāya // 

evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān sarvatathāgatakāyavākcitta(hṛdaya)vajrayoṣidbhageṣu vijahāra // 

tatra khalu bhagavān aśītikoṭiyogīśvaramadhye vajragarbham avalokaḥ smitam akārṣīt // 

samanantaraṃ smite 'smin vajragarbha utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtāñjalipuṭottatvā bhagavantam etad avocat // 

śrotum icchāmi jñānendra sarvatantranidānakaṃ / 
rahasyaṃ saṃpuṭodbhūtaṃ lakṣaṇam // 

bhagavān āha //
